name: Milliray
long_description:
We make radars that can see small drones.

As drones evolve faster than air defenses, detection has fallen behind. Even $50 drones now present a major threat to airports, critical infrastructure, and front-line defense.

We solve this by building high-frequency radar systems, designed from the ground up to detect even the most challenging low-signature targets. This allows us to identify and track nano drones like no other solution, letting you know what's truly in your airspace.
one_liner: Technology to detect and track small drones

launches.title: DroneTector: high-resolution radars to detect small drones
launches.tagline: We build sensors to detect the most challenging drones.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Drone threats have evolved. Detection technology hasn’t and makes lots of mistakes. We solve this with a suite of sensors, including our millimeter-wave radar, purpose-built for the hardest targets. If you’re responsible for countering drone threats, get in touch at [founders@dronetector.com](mailto:founders@dronetector.com).

**The problem**

Small drones are now a security problem. They’re cheap, widely available, and increasingly capable. As a result, they’re showing up in places they shouldn’t – from airports and critical infrastructure to prisons and defense environments.

Detecting them reliably, however, is still a hard problem.

Most drone detection systems weren’t designed for small, low-cost drones. False positives are common, and real threats are missed.

That’s why we’re building [@DroneTector](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/31144).

**Our solution** 

DroneTector provides millimeter-wave radar engineered to detect small drones that others miss. Integrated with our camera and acoustic arrays, we deliver reliable detection against the most challenging targets.

See our technology in action: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=50xAb06cyq4>

Our sensors can operate as a standalone solution or as part of a distributed detection network. They’re highly scalable, adaptable to complex environments, and able to detect drones that other solutions simply can’t. 

**The team**

We’re a team of PhDs from top UK universities with highly relevant expertise. We’ve been supported by the **UK MoD’s Defence and Security Accelerator**, **NATO DIANA** and the **Royal Academy of Engineering**. 

**Dr Matthew Moore (CEO) -** Matthew holds a PhD from the University of St Andrews, specializing in millimeter-wave radar for drone detection. He has extensive RF engineering experience and is a Royal Academy of Engineering Enterprise Fellow. 

**Dr Thomas Doherty (CTO) -** Thomas holds a PhD from the University of Oxford, and has a decade of experience in optical and laser technologies. He brings engineering physics expertise and is a Royal Academy of Engineering Enterprise Fellow. 

**Dr Jordina Frances de Mas (COO) -** Jordina holds a PhD from the University of St Andrews, focusing on automated reasoning. She brings deep expertise in machine learning and algorithmic optimization.  

**Our ask** 

If you’re responsible for countering the drone threat – **in airports, critical infrastructure, venues, VIP protection, or defense** – we’d love to talk. Contact us at [founders@dronetector.com](mailto:founders@dronetector.com).
